# Security Policy

## Reporting

Report vulnerabilities privately to **m.faisalaffan@gmail.com**. Do not open a public issue.

Response within 48 hours. Disclosure after fix is released.

## Scope

- API input validation
- Authentication/authorization bypass
- SQL injection
- Race conditions in balance operations

## Out of Scope

- Missing HTTP security headers (handled by reverse proxy)
- Rate limiting (not yet implemented)
